title: A Graph-Transformer for Whole Slide Image Classification

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《A Graph-Transformer for Whole Slide Image Classification》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Deep learning is a powerful tool for whole slide image (WSI) analysis.

evidence.text: Deep learning is a powerful tool for whole slide image (WSI) analysis.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《A Graph-Transformer for Whole Slide Image Classification》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】Typically, when performing supervised deep learning, a WSI is divided into small patches, trained and the outcomes are aggregated to estimate disease grade.

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】However, patch-based methods introduce label noise during training by assuming that each patch is independent with the same label as the WSI and neglect overall WSI-level information that is significant in disease grading.

evidence.text: Typically, when performing supervised deep learning, a WSI is divided into small patches, trained and the outcomes are aggregated to estimate disease grade.

However, patch-based methods introduce label noise during training by assuming that each patch is independent with the same label as the WSI and neglect overall WSI-level information that is significant in disease grading.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《A Graph-Transformer for Whole Slide Image Classification》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-8】Our model trained on the CPTAC data achieved consistently high performance on three-label classification (normal versus LUAD versus LSCC: mean accuracy = 91.2 ± 2.5%) based on five-fold cross-validation, and mean accuracy = 82.3 ± 1.0% on external test data (TCGA).

evidence.text: Our model trained on the CPTAC data achieved consistently high performance on three-label classification (normal versus LUAD versus LSCC: mean accuracy = 91.2 ± 2.5%) based on five-fold cross-validation, and mean accuracy = 82.3 ± 1.0% on external test data (TCGA).
